description: This file defines the TransnodesSubController class in the Goteo project's Admin namespace. It manages administrative actions related to translation nodes, such as listing, editing, assigning, and unassigning translators to nodes. It includes permission checks, handles HTTP requests, and interacts with models like Node, User, and Feed.

classes.name: TransnodesSubController
classes.description: Controller handling administrative translation node operations like listing, editing, assigning, and unassigning translators, with permission checks.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the user has permissions to manipulate given node, limited to superadmins and root roles on the master node.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles the request to edit a translation node, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: assignAction
methods.description: Handles the request to assign a translator to a node, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: unassignAction
methods.description: Handles the request to remove a translator from a node, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles listing of translation nodes, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Core method that handles different actions ('list', 'edit', 'assign', 'unassign'), performs permission checks, updates models, logs activities, and returns data for views.
